title: With no untracked parts, searching not tracked lists nothing
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at a location that has no untracked part.
  • Have a tracked part, part A, at that location whose part number, description and tags contain neither the word not nor the word tracked.
  • Start on that location's Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Replace the search text with not tracked.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed: the search works at this location.

Step 2:

  • No part is listed, and the list shows its usual empty search result.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10819 (Story 6, Search and Sort the Inventory List by Tracking State)
